item.name: Adrenaline
item.effect: Adrenaline is an active ability that gives 10 stacks (30 seconds) of adrenaline, which increases movement speed by 20%, damage by 20%, and disables stamina regeneration while active. It has a 90 second cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Ability that gives 10 stacks (30 seconds) of adrenaline, which increases movement speed by 20%, damage by 20%, and disables stamina regeneration while active.

item.name: Ambush
item.effect: Ambush is a recode-only ability that allows a temporary speed boost according to an ambush multiplier inherent to the species. It can be toggled by pressing the correct active ability key, which may vary between creatures. It automatically deactivates after either a set period of time, when stamina runs out, or after halting movement, whichever happens first. Ambush can be used while sprinting. Activating the ability while another instance of the ability is active will not stack max time and stamina consumption. Additionally, Ambushing disrupts strafing.
item.cardSummary: Recode-only ability that allows a temporary speed boost according to an ambush multiplier inherent to the species.

item.name: Area Food Restore
item.effect: Pierry using food restore ability on ribs. Area Food Restore is a ranged active ability with a cooldown of 600 seconds. It refreshes food sources in range. It does not work on eggs from inside a nest. It also passively grants the user a 50% boost to the Enriched status effect from ribs and berries(from 300 max stacks to 450 max stacks).
item.cardSummary: Pierry using food restore ability on ribs.

item.name: Area Water Restore
item.effect: Yenyasha using water restore ability on water. Area Water Restore is a ranged active ability that has a cooldown of 600 seconds. It refreshes part of any in-range drinkable water sources' quality. It also passively grants the user a 100% boost to the Fresh Water status effect from fresh water sources (from 60 to 120 max stacks).
item.cardSummary: Yenyasha using water restore ability on water.

item.name: Area Wind Blast
item.effect: Area Wind Blast is an active ability that has a 60 second cooldown. It charges a "condensed wind" ball, before sending it in the targeted direction to collide with terrain or other creatures. Upon impact, an area of uplifting winds will last for 5 seconds. Creatures caught in it or walking into it (including the user) will be sent upward! There are 3 'power levels' as it charges over 6 seconds, and reactivating the ability will send it out early. The fuller the charge, the more damage, larger AOE, higher launch and slower travel time it has. Its three levels, reached at 0, 2 and 4 seconds of charge, deal a x0.35, x0.65 or x1.0 damage multi...
item.cardSummary: Ability that has a 60 second cooldown.

item.name: Burrower
item.effect: A Burrow prison, where all burrow tunnels are one-way entry only. Burrower is an active ability that allows the user to place up to 4 (or a specific creature limit) burrows anywhere on the map and use burrows created by other players. If a user places more entrances than the maximum allowed, the oldest burrow and exit will be replaced. A user cannot place a burrow entrance inside its own burrow or inside someone else's burrow. There is a 3 second cooldown between entering and exiting burrows, excluding entering a burrow after its initial placement.
item.cardSummary: A Burrow prison, where all burrow tunnels are one-way entry only.

item.name: Cause Fear
item.effect: Cause Fear is an active ability and Recode's equivalent of Fear. It gives all creatures within 150 studs of the user 10 stacks (30 seconds) of Fear Status effect, and has a cooldown of 120 seconds (2 minutes).
item.cardSummary: Ability and Recode's equivalent of Fear.

item.name: Change Weather
item.effect: https://creatures-of-sonaria-official.fandom.com/wiki/File:Creatures_of_Sonaria_-_weather_change! Creatures of Sonaria - weather change! Leftover effect bug. Change Weather is an active ability that forces any current weather to change to a new type, including Thunderstorms. If a natural disaster is already happening, the ability cannot be activated. It can also "appear" to change the day/night cycle (in fact, it really doesn't) if it happens to be night and the ability triggers sunny weather. The ability cannot change a weather immediately after another Change Weather invocation. It can only be used by creatures with age 67 or higher and ...
item.cardSummary: Https://creatures-of-sonaria-official.fandom.com/wiki/File:Creatures_of_Sonaria_-_weather_change!

item.name: Cocoon
item.effect: Cocoon is an active ability that gradually slows the user down over the course of 5 seconds until coming to a halt, after which they will lay down and become invulnerable to damage. While slowing down, the user can still bite, use other abilities, and have their defensive status effects trigger, but they also still take damage and can be killed during this window. Once they lay down, the user also becomes immune to new status effects and can no longer bite or use other abilities, and will rapidly heal 30% of their maximum health. The user is granted 6.66 stacks of a 15% damage boost after this process ends. The laying animation triggered b...
item.cardSummary: Ability that gradually slows the user down over the course of 5 seconds until coming to a halt, after which they will lay down and become invulnerable to damage.

item.name: Corrosion Aura
item.effect: Previously known as "Radiation" when Radiation status had been removed, it was the first type of Aura in Recode, from which the others derived from. It is a subtype of Aura which deals Corrosion status.
item.cardSummary: Previously known as "Radiation" when Radiation status had been removed, it was the first type of Aura in Recode, from which the others derived from.

item.name: Cursed Sigil
item.effect: Cursed Sigil is an active ability that offensively inflicts the Bad Omen status on anyone in a 100 stud radius centered on the user. It has an 85 second cooldown after use.
item.cardSummary: Ability that offensively inflicts the Bad Omen status on anyone in a 100 stud radius centered on the user.

item.name: Damage Link
item.effect: Damage Link is an active ability that can affect up to three creatures at once within a 60 stud radius centered on the user. When any one of the linked creatures is damaged/healed by an unlinked creature, the other linked creatures take 80% of the damage/heal taken by the initially hit creature. The links last for 20 seconds, but can be broken if the linked creatures put 90 studs or greater between them. This ability has a 45 second cooldown after use.
item.cardSummary: Ability that can affect up to three creatures at once within a 60 stud radius centered on the user.

item.name: Dazzling Flash
item.effect: Dazzling Flash is an active ability that generates a quick white flash and causes nearby creatures to experience confusion, Tunnel Vision, and Blurred Vision. It has a 70 second cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Ability that generates a quick white flash and causes nearby creatures to experience confusion, Tunnel Vision, and Blurred Vision.

item.name: Defiled Ground
item.effect: Defiled Ground is an active ability with a 10-minute cooldown. When activated, the user places a plagued zone that rots nearby player-dropped meat, using it to fuel its growth through three stages. While inside the zone, the user gains buffs that scale with its current stage: +5%, +7.5%, or +10% maximum health, the same increase to weight, 10%, 20%, or 30% faster ailment recovery, and 20%, 50%, or 80% reduced hunger and thirst drain. Nearby creatures other than the user's packmates are inflicted with Sickly over time. The zone lingers for a short time after the user leaves and decays if abandoned for too long.
item.cardSummary: Ability with a 10-minute cooldown.

item.name: Disease Aura
item.effect: A subtype of Aura which deals Disease status.
item.cardSummary: Recode active ability that helps players understand Disease Aura mechanics.

item.name: Divination
item.effect: Divination is an active ability. Upon activation, the user charges up a bar for 15 seconds which summons 3 orbiting charms when it finishes filling. Attacking packmates will heal them for 10% of their max HP and cleanse 2 stacks each of bleed, burn, poison, corrosion, necropoison, radiation, disease, frostbite, freeze, injury and torn ligaments, while attacking enemies deals +50 bonus damage and 2 stacks of Burn. Attacking anyone uses up a charm. The charms last for 30 seconds before dissipating. Cancelling the channel early by pressing the ability button again or attacking will grant their effects immediately. If the user attacks a packma...
item.cardSummary: Ability.

item.name: Drowsy Area
item.effect: Drowsy Area is an active ability that gives those within a 150 stud radius 5 stacks of the Drowsy status and 5 stacks of Slowed. Has a 60 second cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Ability that gives those within a 150 stud radius 5 stacks of the Drowsy status and 5 stacks of Slowed.

item.name: Earthquake
item.effect: Earthquake is an ability that emits a cartoonish smoke-blast that inflicts the Injury aliment on all creatures within a 125 stud radius. Applies 1 Shredded Wings & 4 Broken Bones to those in AOE. Deals 40 Injury, however, the amount of Injury gained can be reduced based off of the percentage of Injury block the creature has. It costs 25% Stamina to use and applies 4 Aftershock to the user. Has a 5 minute cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Ability that emits a cartoonish smoke-blast that inflicts the Injury aliment on all creatures within a 125 stud radius.

item.name: Egg Stealer
item.effect: A baby Arcabatur using its Egg Stealer ability to grab an egg A Alkaksu using its Egg Stealer ability to grab an old-textured egg Egg Stealer is an active ability that allows creatures to steal eggs from the nests of other players. If a creature has this ability, eggs are also highlighted with an egg icon when scenting.
item.cardSummary: A baby Arcabatur using its Egg Stealer ability to grab an egg A Alkaksu using its Egg Stealer ability to grab an old-textured egg Egg Stealer is an active ability that allows...

item.name: Escape Area
item.effect: Escape Area is an active ability that causes 40% total HP damage to the user in exchange for a 75% above-ground movement speed boost and a 50% damage debuff for 10 stacks. It has a 75 second cooldown. Additionally, any of the user's depleted stamina is fully replenished. It cannot be used if the user is at less 40% health total.
item.cardSummary: Ability that causes 40% total HP damage to the user in exchange for a 75% above-ground movement speed boost and a 50% damage debuff for 10 stacks.

item.name: Expunge
item.effect: Expunge is an active ability. When activated, it applies a red smoke effect around the user's head, with a bar indicating how long the effect is active (15 seconds). When the effect is active, the user may bite another creature once to clear all of the creature's current Bleed and hit harder for it: the bite's final damage is normal bite damage × (1 + 0.05 × Bleed stacks removed), i.e. +5% for each stack cleared. The user is then healed by half of that added damage. Because the bonus is a share of the bite, it scales with weight. It has a 45 second cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Ability.

item.name: Fortify
item.effect: Phugu using its fortify ability to wipe poison effect Fortify is an active ability with a 90-second cooldown that wipes almost all status effects deemed as negative, excluding thirst, hunger, plushie-derived effects, and weather effects. It will also wipe beneficial status effects if they contain at least one debuff. It grants a short immunity to all status effects gained after being activated, and increases weight by 5% for a short period according to the stack number (3, in this case).
item.cardSummary: Phugu using its fortify ability to wipe poison effect Fortify is an active ability with a 90-second cooldown that wipes almost all status effects deemed as negative, excluding...

item.name: Frost Nova
item.effect: Frost Nova is an active ability that applies 3 stacks of the Frostbite ailment every 3 seconds to nearby creatures in a specified range for 15 seconds after it is activated. The range of Frost Nova depends on the creature. It has a cooldown of 60 seconds.
item.cardSummary: Ability that applies 3 stacks of the Frostbite ailment every 3 seconds to nearby creatures in a specified range for 15 seconds after it is activated.

item.name: Frost Snare
item.effect: Frost Snare is an active ability that places a tether on all creatures within 85 studs of a user, dealing 5 frostbite. Tethered creatures are trapped within Frost Snare's range and cannot leave until either 20 seconds have passed or the tether is broken. Tethers have 100 health, and any damage dealt to them is restrained to 20–25 damage per bite, requiring a minimum of 5 or 4 hits to break. Being tethered also disables Grab and Latch until freed. Frost Snare has a cooldown of 120 seconds.
item.cardSummary: Ability that places a tether on all creatures within 85 studs of a user, dealing 5 frostbite.

item.name: Gale
item.effect: Gale is an active ability that slows down nearby creatures' swim and sprint speeds by 20%, in addition to zooming out their camera. Upon activation, a translucid shockwave-like effect will appear and explode, only to contract a second later. Has a 90 second cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Ability that slows down nearby creatures' swim and sprint speeds by 20%, in addition to zooming out their camera.

item.name: Grab
item.effect: Grab is an active ability that allows the user to pick up a lower-tiered creature as long as they are 20% lighter than the user. Grabbed creatures can escape almost immediately after grab has been successfully used by pressing any button. The user can ungrab at any moment by pressing the same button used to grab. A creature darting from outside/inside water will grab any creature it finds automatically. Though, since Grab has a 8 second cooldown, if a creature darts to grab while the cooldown is active, the grab will not work.
item.cardSummary: Ability that allows the user to pick up a lower-tiered creature as long as they are 20% lighter than the user.

item.name: Grim Lariat
item.effect: Grim Lariat is an active ability that applies 8 stacks of Heartbroken(up to a maximum of 10) to all nearby creatures within a 75 stud radius and 50% of the player creature's damage in an AoE. It has a cooldown of 60 seconds, and the creature must be over age 66 to use it.
item.cardSummary: Ability that applies 8 stacks of Heartbroken(up to a maximum of 10) to all nearby creatures within a 75 stud radius and 50% of the player creature's damage in an AoE.

item.name: Harden
item.effect: Harden is an active ability that applies 10 stacks of the Harden buff, which decreases movement speed by 20% in exchange for a 35% increase in weight and 25% increase in health regeneration. Does not affect turning rate or turning speed. Cooldown is 120 seconds.
item.cardSummary: Ability that applies 10 stacks of the Harden buff, which decreases movement speed by 20% in exchange for a 35% increase in weight and 25% increase in health regeneration.

item.name: Heal Aura
item.effect: Heal Aura is a toggleable active ability that performs a total % HP healing to creatures in a 175 stud range from the user, excluding the user itself. The raw amount of HP healed is different according to the creature. It has a 5-second cooldown after being toggled on but can be deactivated at any time. While active, the user emits a large green plus sign that fades in and out, and all nearby creatures will have positive healing numbers.
item.cardSummary: Toggleable active ability that performs a total % HP healing to creatures in a 175 stud range from the user, excluding the user itself.

item.name: Healing Hunter
item.effect: Healing Hunter is a toggleable active ability that allows the user to deal melee hits that replenish the target's HP when hitting. This ability also allows the healer to toggle between melee heal mode and regular attack mode, where the healer's bites deal melee damage instead. It also prevents bleed and poison-booster plushies from giving extra offensive bleed or poison when hitting under healing mode. If a creature with this ability is on healing mode, they are surrounded by a pink hollow sphere with pink cross particles.
item.cardSummary: Toggleable active ability that allows the user to deal melee hits that replenish the target's HP when hitting.

item.name: Healing Pulse
item.effect: Healing Pulse is an active ability that applies 10 stacks of the Healing Ailment to all creatures within 175 studs of the user, including themselves. The 10 stacks last 28-30 seconds, approximately enough for two ticks of healing since they have 15 second intervals. When used, a spark explosion effect appears from the user. Has a 90 second cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Ability that applies 10 stacks of the Healing Ailment to all creatures within 175 studs of the user, including themselves.

item.name: Hunters Curse
item.effect: Hunters Curse is an active ability that costs half of total health to use but grants 10 stacks (30 seconds) of the Hunters Curse status, which increases damage by 100%. It has a 120 second cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Ability that costs half of total health to use but grants 10 stacks (30 seconds) of the Hunters Curse status, which increases damage by 100%.

item.name: Ink Cloud
item.effect: Ink Cloud is an active ability that creates a cloud of ink, rendering the user invisible and granting it two stacks of the Escape Area status effect. Creatures within the cloud will be given the Inked status effect, which blurs vision, causes confusion, and adds an ink overlay to the screen. The cloud lingers for 90 seconds and has a 90 second cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Ability that creates a cloud of ink, rendering the user invisible and granting it two stacks of the Escape Area status effect.

item.name: Invisibility
item.effect: An invisible creature on recode with max graphics Invisibility is an active ability that makes the user invisible to other players when toggled. Invisibility allows the user to walk and swim cloaked as long as they don't bite, use any active ability, sprint, ambush, or jump/fly/glide. While active it does not hide the creature from being spotted by scent. Additionally, invisibility has a 30 second cooldown after being activated; however, deactivating the ability does not modify the cooldown.
item.cardSummary: An invisible creature on recode with max graphics Invisibility is an active ability that makes the user invisible to other players when toggled.

item.name: Lance
item.effect: Lance is an active ability using the breath control (C on PC or https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/creatures-of-agartha-official/images/4/46/BreathIcon.png/revision/latest?cb=20211014041229 on Mobile), similar to Elemental Breath. Upon activating the ability, after 3 seconds, a projectile will fire from the user's mouth in the direction of the user's mouse cursor, with a range of 500 studs. Contact with this projectile deals 5% of max HP damage and two stacks of Slowed, and the area of impact leaves a lingering effect that ticks once per second for 5 seconds, each tick dealing 1% of max HP and a stack of the user's Lance ailment. item.name: Latch
item.effect: An Alkaksu latched onto a custom Chisudo Latch is an active ability that allows the user to latch onto higher-tiered creatures. Creatures that the user has latched into cannot escape for 5 seconds. After that, the latched creature can struggle by pressing any button and will release such creature from the latch. The user can unlatch at any moment by pressing the same button used to latch in the first place.
item.cardSummary: An Alkaksu latched onto a custom Chisudo Latch is an active ability that allows the user to latch onto higher-tiered creatures.

item.name: Lich Mark
item.effect: Lich Mark is an active ability that, when activated, grants the user five seconds to attack another player and apply the Lich Mark status. Lich Mark is removed from affected players if attacked again, replacing it with 5 stacks of a variable ailment specific to the user species (e.g. poison, frostbite, etcetera). The status can also be removed with time. It has a cooldown of 30 seconds.
item.cardSummary: Ability that, when activated, grants the user five seconds to attack another player and apply the Lich Mark status.

item.name: Life Leech
item.effect: Life Leech is an active ability that allows the user to heal themselves for a certain percentage (%) of damage done to other players while the ability is active. It lasts for 12 seconds and has a 60 second cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Ability that allows the user to heal themselves for a certain percentage (%) of damage done to other players while the ability is active.

item.name: Lure
item.effect: Lure is an active ability with a 30 second cooldown that consists of placing a fake collectable mushroom or token lure that lasts 25 seconds and at the same time that makes the user invisible. On collection from another creature, the token vanishes and inflicts 2 necropoison, 2 confusion, 3 slowed, and 5% of the collecting creature's max HP as damage. User invisibility ends if the user attacks, sprints, the token has been collected or despawns, or 25 seconds have passed since the lure was placed, whatever happens first.
item.cardSummary: Ability with a 30 second cooldown that consists of placing a fake collectable mushroom or token lure that lasts 25 seconds and at the same time that makes the user invisible.

item.name: Moon Beam
item.effect: Moon Beam is an active ability which summons a beam of moonlight at the mouse location which seeks out and slowly follows the nearest player. While in the beam's light, nearby creatures will gain the BlueMoon status, and creatures in the user's pack are healed for 2% per tick. The ability lasts 15 seconds and has a 180 second cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Ability which summons a beam of moonlight at the mouse location which seeks out and slowly follows the nearest player.

item.name: Mud Pile
item.effect: Mud Pile is an active ability that allows the user to place a mud pile that lasts for 60 seconds. Creatures can wallow in the mud to gain healing Muddy status and unscentable status for 90 seconds. Comparison between an Alkaksu's mud pile and a natural mud pile Muddy Status indicator with old green (now yellow) unscentable status indicator.
item.cardSummary: Ability that allows the user to place a mud pile that lasts for 60 seconds.

item.name: Poison Area
item.effect: Poison Area/Area Poison is an active ability that inflicts 5 stacks (15 seconds) of the Poison Status to all nearby creatures within 100 studs, excluding the user, with a 15 second cooldown.

item.cardSummary: Recode active ability that helps players understand Radiation Aura mechanics.

item.name: Reflect
item.effect: Reflect is an active ability. Upon initial use, it will grant the user 2 stacks of Reflect Status. It has a cooldown of 45 seconds.
item.cardSummary: Ability.

item.effect: Reflux is an Active Ability, similar to Breath, activated by using (C on PC or https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/creatures-of-agartha-official/images/4/46/BreathIcon.png/revision/latest?cb=20211014041229 on Mobile). item.name: Rewind
item.effect: Rewind is an ability that restores a user's health and position to what it was 9 seconds ago, up to 25% of its max health. It has a 100 second cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Ability that restores a user's health and position to what it was 9 seconds ago, up to 25% of its max health.

item.name: Shadow Barrage
item.effect: Shadow Barrage is an active ability that deals repeated damage to the last player the user attacks. Upon activation, that player will receive the "Shadow" attack, which takes the damage applied by the last bite the opponent took within 10 seconds of being triggered, and then applies it a number of times equal to the user's Shadow Barrage value. It has a 10% damage dropoff per hit (the first hit at 90%, the next at 81%, and so on) and deals any passive ailments associated with the user's bite during a "Shadow" attack. It has a cooldown of 30 seconds. If the target has Reflect active when the barrage lands, the 10% dropoff is ignored and eve...
item.cardSummary: Ability that deals repeated damage to the last player the user attacks.

item.name: Shock Area
item.effect: The Shock Area active ability inflicts Shock Status, Broken Legs Status, and slows down flight speed by 60% for 30 seconds when used. It has a 90 second cooldown.
item.cardSummary: The Shock Area active ability inflicts Shock Status, Broken Legs Status, and slows down flight speed by 60% for 30 seconds when used.

item.name: Snow Shield
item.effect: The Snow Shield ability creates a large, protective dome around the user. It will only despawn once the user triggers the ability again, until the user leaves or menus, until the shield is broken via biting, or until the user dies. When the Snow Shield ability is active, the user's hunger and thirst will drain three times faster. Upon initial activation of the ability, the user will not be able to create a new dome for another 90 seconds.
item.cardSummary: The Snow Shield ability creates a large, protective dome around the user.

item.name: Speed Blitz
item.effect: https://creatures-of-sonaria-official.fandom.com/wiki/File:Creatures_of_Sonaria-_speed_blitz! Creatures of Sonaria- speed blitz! Speed Blitz is an active ability that will consume half of the user's stamina bar if it is above 50% and apply 6 stacks (18 seconds) of the Speed Blitz Status. It has a 90 second cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Https://creatures-of-sonaria-official.fandom.com/wiki/File:Creatures_of_Sonaria-_speed_blitz!

item.name: Speed Steal
item.effect: Speed Steal is an active ability that provides 4 stacks of Speed Gift Status to the user while giving 4 stacks of Stolen Speed Status to nearby creatures.
item.cardSummary: Ability that provides 4 stacks of Speed Gift Status to the user while giving 4 stacks of Stolen Speed Status to nearby creatures.

item.name: Spite
item.effect: Spite is an active ability that increases a user's next attack damage based on its power meter, which fills from 0% to 100% over 5 seconds once the ability is triggered and then drains to 0 if no creature is attacked by the user during this time. The bonus applied is proportional to how full the meter is when the attack lands, so attacking before it is full gives a smaller bonus. It also has a customizable percentage (%) of the creature's damage (the % listed is the max of said creature's Spite power). A negative spite value indicates that using the ability heals the target, rather than damages. Alongside raw damage, the user inflicts doub...
item.cardSummary: Ability that increases a user's next attack damage based on its power meter, which fills from 0% to 100% over 5 seconds once the ability is triggered and then drains to 0 if no...

item.name: Stamina Puddle
item.effect: Norskogg using its Stamina Puddle ability Stamina Puddle is an active ability that places down a small star-filled puddle. Once a user interacts with the puddle, their stamina will regenerate three times faster for 180 seconds. Placement has a 120 second cooldown. A creature can place more than 1 puddle at a time, but the boost will not stack or reset to max by interacting multiple times with a puddle before the stamina boost fades.
item.cardSummary: Norskogg using its Stamina Puddle ability Stamina Puddle is an active ability that places down a small star-filled puddle.

item.name: Sticky Trap
item.effect: Sticky Trap is an active ability that allows the user to drop a trap which will cause those ensnared to receive the Sticky Trap Status and 4 seconds of Broken Legs Status. It has a 75-second cooldown. Multiple sticky traps can be placed by the same user, but if two sticky traps of the same user are too close from each another, the oldest one will disappear. If more than 2 sticky traps are placed at one time, the oldest one will eventually despawn. Sticky traps can be destroyed if they receive enough hits.
item.cardSummary: Ability that allows the user to drop a trap which will cause those ensnared to receive the Sticky Trap Status and 4 seconds of Broken Legs Status.

item.name: Tail Drop
item.effect: Tail Drop is an active ability which allows a user to intentionally self-amputate a its tail. After committing this action, the user gains the Tail Dropped status, and the tail becomes a meat drop that provides enriched when eaten. If the tail comes from a Photovore or Photocarnivore, it can also be eaten by Herbivores. It has a 10 second cooldown. It takes some percent of the hunger bar to regrow the tail (unless a creature menus).
item.cardSummary: Ability which allows a user to intentionally self-amputate a its tail.

item.name: Tail Whip
item.effect: Tail Whip is an active ability that grants the user grants another melee attack from behind. It is activated according to where the camera is facing. It has a secondary damage stat, which allows main and secondary melee attacks to deal different base damage. It is affected the same way as the main bite by damage bonuses such as the Blood Moon, the Aggressive buff, and damage boosting plushies. No offensive status effects are given from this secondary attack.
item.cardSummary: Ability that grants the user grants another melee attack from behind.

item.name: Thorn Trap
item.effect: Thorn Trap is an active ability that allows the user to drop a trap of thorny plant growth. When a creature triggers a trap, it disappears, and they receive 5% of their max HP, six stacks of Bleed/Bleed Status and two stacks of FREEZE, which temporarily immobilize the target's actions. It has a 35-second cooldown. Up to 3 thorn traps can be placed by the same creature. If more than 3 thorn traps are placed at one time, the oldest one will despawn.
item.cardSummary: Ability that allows the user to drop a trap of thorny plant growth.

item.name: Totem
item.effect: Totem is an active ability that allows an adult creature to drop a "lamp" totem (made out of crystals, rocks, and other natural materials). Totems may be placed mid air or in the water, however they will drop to the ground/seafloor below them. It will affect any creature within 250 studs range (except the user who placed it and its packmates, immune) with a lingering effect of stacking 2 extra of the specified ailment (traditionally, Poison Status) every 3 seconds. This effect lasts until the totem despawns (after 2 minutes) or destroyed after enough hits. The time to kill for totems is the same regardless of bite cooldown. Once placed, th...
item.cardSummary: Ability that allows an adult creature to drop a "lamp" totem (made out of crystals, rocks, and other natural materials).

item.name: Toxic Trap

item.name: Radiation Trail
item.effect: Radiation Trail is a passive ability activated only when the user is below a creature-specific health percentage. It leaves behind a trail made up of segments that last for 5 seconds before despawning. Stepping on the trail deals 2% of max HP and 2 stacks of Radiation every 2 seconds.

item.cardSummary: Ability activated only when the user is below a creature-specific health percentage.

item.name: Block Bleed
item.effect: Bleed Block/Block Bleed is a percentage based passive ability that grants the user resistance to getting bleed status from melee attacks at minimum. If an attacker deals 5 bleed per hit and the receiver has 60% Block Bleed, then the receiver gets only 2 of that 5 bleed. This ability is gained gradually as the creature ages. If a creature's Block Bleed is 100%, then they are immune to Bleed inflicted by melee direct attacks once fully grown. If a creature's Block Bleed is negative, it may indicate an extra vulnerability to the status effect.
item.cardSummary: Bleed Block/Block Bleed is a percentage based passive ability that grants the user resistance to getting bleed status from melee attacks at minimum.

item.name: Block Burn
item.effect: Burn Block/Block Burn is a passive ability that grants the user resistance to getting burn status from melee attacks. It is percentage based. For example, if an attacker deals 5 burn per hit and the receiver has 60% block burn, then the receiver gets only 2 of that 5 burn. If a creature's block burn is 100%, then they are immune to Burn inflicted by melee direct attacks once fully grown. This ability is gained gradually as the creature ages. A negative value may indicate that the creature is vulnerable to burn effects.
item.cardSummary: Burn Block/Block Burn is a passive ability that grants the user resistance to getting burn status from melee attacks.

item.name: Block Corrosion
item.effect: Block Corrosion/Corrosion Defense is a passive ability that grants resistance to corrosion status. It works by blocking a percentage of the ailment received. If a creature's Corrosion Block is 100%, then they are immune to that status (and will be healed instantly if they are somehow applied).
item.cardSummary: Block Corrosion/Corrosion Defense is a passive ability that grants resistance to corrosion status.

item.name: Block Disease
item.effect: Disease Block/Block Disease is a passive ability that grants the user partial resistance to getting the Disease status from attacks. It is percentage based. For example, if an attacker deals 5 Disease per hit and the receiver has 60% Block Disease, then the receiver gets only 2 of 6 stacks. If a creature's Block Disease is 100%, then they are immune to Disease inflicted by melee direct attacks once fully grown. This ability is gained gradually as the creature ages.
item.cardSummary: Disease Block/Block Disease is a passive ability that grants the user partial resistance to getting the Disease status from attacks.

item.name: Block Frostbite
item.effect: Frostbite Block/Block Frostbite is a passive ability that grants the user resistance to getting frostbite status from melee attacks at the very least, and every other source at most. It is percentage based, e.g. if an attacker deals 5 frostbite per hit and the receiver has 60% block frostbite, then the receiver gets only 2 of that 5 frostbite.
item.cardSummary: Frostbite Block/Block Frostbite is a passive ability that grants the user resistance to getting frostbite status from melee attacks at the very least, and every other source at most.

item.name: Block Injury
item.effect: Injury Block/Block Injury is a passive ability that grants the user resistance to getting Injury status from melee attacks at the very least. It is percentage based, e.g. if an attacker deals 5 Injury per hit and the receiver has 60% Injury Block, then the receiver gets only 2 of that 5 Injury.
item.cardSummary: Injury Block/Block Injury is a passive ability that grants the user resistance to getting Injury status from melee attacks at the very least.

item.name: Block Necropoison
item.effect: Block Necropoison is a resistance against the Necropoison Status that reduces the amount of status absorbed and damage dealt by it when accumulating this status.
item.cardSummary: Resistance against the Necropoison Status that reduces the amount of status absorbed and damage dealt by it when accumulating this status.

item.name: Block Poison
item.effect: Block Poison/Poison Block is a passive ability that grants resistance to poison status once they reach max age (100). Like many other block defenses, it works by blocking a percentage of the ailment received. If a creature's Poison Block is 100%, then they are immune to those stats (and will be healed instantly if they are somehow applied) once they reach age 100.
item.cardSummary: Block Poison/Poison Block is a passive ability that grants resistance to poison status once they reach max age (100).

item.name: Block Radiation
item.effect: Block Radiation/Radiation Block/Radiation Defense is a passive ability that grants resistance to radiation status. Like many other block defenses, it works by blocking a percentage of the ailment received. If a creature's Radiation Block is 100%, then they are immune to those stats (and will be healed instantly if they are somehow applied) once they reach age 100.
item.cardSummary: Block Radiation/Radiation Block/Radiation Defense is a passive ability that grants resistance to radiation status.

item.name: Breath Resistance
item.effect: Breath Damage Resistance is a passive ability that decreases the percentage of damage received by the user from breath abilities. A 100% breath resistance means full immunity from the damage dealt from breaths, but not for the status effects they afflict, which remain unaffected.
item.cardSummary: Breath Damage Resistance is a passive ability that decreases the percentage of damage received by the user from breath abilities.

item.name: Unbreakable
item.effect: Unbreakable is a passive ability that prevents the user from taking damage that exceeds a certain percent of its HP in a single hit. The percent of damage is indicated by the creature's specific indicated Unbreakable value. For example, if a creature has 30% Unbreakable, it will not take more than 30% of its maximum HP from a single hit. The damage reduction is applied after every other damage modifier, like creatures' weight or the Blood Moon damage boost.
item.cardSummary: Ability that prevents the user from taking damage that exceeds a certain percent of its HP in a single hit.

item.name: Warden's Resistance
item.effect: Warden's Resistance is a passive ability that prevents ailments from being taken below 50% health, with the exception of Shredded Wings, which still applies.
item.cardSummary: Ability that prevents ailments from being taken below 50% health, with the exception of Shredded Wings, which still applies.

item.name: Agile Swimmer
item.effect: Agile Swimmer is a passive ability that causes the player to receive the following buffs when submerged underwater for more than a second: - 100% more stamina regeneration - 50% more total stamina - 75% more walk speed - 75% more sprint speed - A % increase in oxygen (oxygen increase percentage is based off the amount of oxygen the creature originally has) Additionally, a glider semi-aquatic (and an aqua-glider) can abuse the extra stamina to increase the number of glide flaps it can perform from the water boosted. Until they touch the ground or stop gliding, the boosted stamina amount will remain.
item.cardSummary: Ability that causes the player to receive the following buffs when submerged underwater for more than a second: - 100% more stamina regeneration - 50% more total stamina - 75% more...

item.name: Berserk
item.effect: Berserk is a passive ability that activates at below 20% health. It increases stamina regeneration by 100% and decreases bite cooldown by 50%.
item.cardSummary: Ability that activates at below 20% health.

item.name: Broodwatcher
item.effect: Broodwatcher is a passive ability that allows users to assist in the gestation of other players' eggs. It applies one stack of Gestation to nearby creatures, which increases other creatures' egg gestation speed by 2.5%. The total buff any nesting species can receive is 5%, so only two Broodwatchers can be effective at any one time. Additionally, when sitting near a nest, the Broodwatcher gains 5 Defensive, which starts to decrease if they move.
item.cardSummary: Ability that allows users to assist in the gestation of other players' eggs.

item.name: Channeling
item.effect: Channeling is a passive ability that activates when a user with it is at 25% or less health. Every 5 seconds, any creature within a 150 stud radius of the user will receive 3 shock status and 2 confusion status. The status effects stack with each strike.
item.cardSummary: Ability that activates when a user with it is at 25% or less health.

item.name: Climber
item.effect: Climber is a passive ability that allows the user to walk on walls and ceilings. To detach from a wall, press the Space on PC. On Mobile, press the dedicated Detach button, or, if the creature has Jump, press the jump button.
item.cardSummary: Ability that allows the user to walk on walls and ceilings.

item.name: Diver
item.effect: Diver is a passive ability that grants the user the ability to temporarily keep flying underwater for a short period of time while retaining their diving speed. The exact period of time varies per creature.
item.cardSummary: Ability that grants the user the ability to temporarily keep flying underwater for a short period of time while retaining their diving speed.

item.name: Frosty
item.effect: Frosty is a passive ability that causes the user to receive +25% stamina regeneration, +25% health regeneration, -25% thirst depletion, and -25% hunger depletion during Winter and Famine. Additionally, it prevents getting hypothermia from blizzards.
item.cardSummary: Ability that causes the user to receive +25% stamina regeneration, +25% health regeneration, -25% thirst depletion, and -25% hunger depletion during Winter and Famine.

item.name: Gourmandizer
item.effect: Gourmandizer is a passive ability that allows users to overfill their food bar (water for Photovores) by up to 150%. Doing so applies up to 15% more weight and reduces speed by up to 7.5%. The higher above max appetite the creature is, up to 125%, the higher the applied effects are, capped at the aforementioned values. Overfilled appetite meters drain 1.5x faster than normal.
item.cardSummary: Ability that allows users to overfill their food bar (water for Photovores) by up to 150%.

item.name: Guilt
item.effect: Guilt/Defensive Guilt is a passive ability that halves the amount of damage taken upon being bitten.
item.cardSummary: Guilt/Defensive Guilt is a passive ability that halves the amount of damage taken upon being bitten.

item.name: Healing Step
item.effect: Healing Step is a passive ability that activates when the user's health drops to 65% or less. The user leaves a healing trail that restores its value as a percentage of max health every 2 seconds to both the user and any recipients who step in it. This ability only affects the user and their packmates, and the trail is visible only to them. Each trail segment lasts for 8 seconds, with a maximum of 13 segments active at a time.
item.cardSummary: Ability that activates when the user's health drops to 65% or less.

item.name: Hunker
item.effect: Hunker is a passive ability that activates when a user with this ability strafes. While active, hunker reduces the creature's speed by 25%, damage by 50%, and reduces damage taken by a percentage based on what is listed for the creature. For example, a creature with 75 hunker will only receive 25% of damage while the ability is active.
item.cardSummary: Ability that activates when a user with this ability strafes.

item.name: Iron Stomach
item.effect: Iron Stomach is a passive ability that allows the user to eat rotten meat without getting negative ailments from it--preventing them from getting the Sickly Status.
item.cardSummary: Ability that allows the user to eat rotten meat without getting negative ailments from it--preventing them from getting the Sickly Status.

item.name: Keen Observer
item.effect: Keen Observer is a passive ability that allows the user to see the health, equipped Plushies, Traits, and status effects of nearby creatures with a green HP bar over them. Temporary status buffs are set on green, temporary status debuffs on red, traits now present their correct indicator and plushies are marked with their plushie icon.
item.cardSummary: Ability that allows the user to see the health, equipped Plushies, Traits, and status effects of nearby creatures with a green HP bar over them.

item.name: Overcharged
item.effect: Overcharged is a passive ability applied to mechanical, electrical or similar creatures of that type. It grants the ability for lightning strikes from Thunderstorms to strike the user and apply a temporary buff.
item.cardSummary: Ability applied to mechanical, electrical or similar creatures of that type.

item.name: Pack Healer
item.effect: Pack Healer is a passive ability in which all creatures within 150 studs of the user have their health regeneration boosted by 25%, similar to the status effect Muddy. Pack Healer functions similarly to an AOE active ability. Unlike the title, which suggests this is a pack ability, Pack Healer buffs any player within the radius regardless if they are packed with the user or not. This information was confirmed by JarOfTar on the official Discord server as can be seen here and here.
item.cardSummary: Ability in which all creatures within 150 studs of the user have their health regeneration boosted by 25%, similar to the status effect Muddy.

item.name: Quick Recovery
item.effect: Quick Recovery is a passive ability that boosts HP regeneration when the user's health is below 40%. The lower the health, the higher the HP regeneration boost, reaching double (x2) at 0% health..
item.cardSummary: Ability that boosts HP regeneration when the user's health is below 40%.

item.name: Raider
item.effect: Raider is a passive ability that allows users to enter and exit burrows, but not create them. Raiding requires a 3 second wait period after interacting with the burrow, during which the user must remain still. Additionally, if the the burrow owner is inside of their burrow, they will be alerted of the raider's entry attempt.
item.cardSummary: Ability that allows users to enter and exit burrows, but not create them.

item.name: Self-Destruct
item.effect: Self-Destruct is a passive ability that activates when the user drops to 15% hp or less. It applies 3 stacks of a 25% movement increase, and once these stacks run out (or the user dies), the creature explodes. If the user's HP is above 15% at that point it is cut down to 15%; if it is already lower, nothing happens. The explosion deals 10% of nearby creatures' max hp, applies 10 stacks of burn and knocks everyone in the area back greatly. If the user is still alive after the explosion, they receive two stacks of the Slowed ailment. It has a cooldown of five minutes.
item.cardSummary: Ability that activates when the user drops to 15% hp or less.

item.name: Silent Hunter
item.effect: Silent Hunter is a passive ability that dampens the visual audio cues caused by the user sprinting or flying, making them harder to detect. This only affects players with radial sound detection enabled.
item.cardSummary: Ability that dampens the visual audio cues caused by the user sprinting or flying, making them harder to detect.

item.name: Soft Landing
item.effect: Soft Landing is a passive ability that allows the user to fall more slowly, depending on each creature's specific stat number. It works when walking off cliffs/falling, detaching, darting, or jumping. It is cancellable by pressing (Space on PC or https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/creatures-of-agartha-official/images/5/53/SpaceIconRecode.png/revision/latest?cb=20231022124530 or B on Xbox).
item.cardSummary: Ability that allows the user to fall more slowly, depending on each creature's specific stat number.

item.name: Sonic Wings
item.effect: Sonic Wings is a passive ability that allows the user to idle while flying without consuming or regaining stamina.
item.cardSummary: Ability that allows the user to idle while flying without consuming or regaining stamina.

item.name: Sticky Fur
item.effect: Sticky Fur is a passive ability that inflicts 2 stacks of the Sticky Teeth Status(up to a maximum of 5) on the attacker when bitten.
item.cardSummary: Ability that inflicts 2 stacks of the Sticky Teeth Status(up to a maximum of 5) on the attacker when bitten.

item.name: Strength In Numbers
item.effect: Strength In Numbers is a passive ability that gives the user a 7% stamina regeneration boost and a 1.5% damage boost. It stacks according to how many creatures with the same ability and species are nearby. If there are no other users with this ability nearby, it will not provide the boost.
item.cardSummary: Ability that gives the user a 7% stamina regeneration boost and a 1.5% damage boost.

item.name: Stubborn Stacker
item.effect: Stubborn Stacker is a passive ability that overwrites the effects of offensive ailment plushies with new ones, those being: Cat Plushie: +10% HealthRegen, +5% BlockBleed, Pig-Lantern Plushie: +5% Damage, +5% BlockBurn, Haunt Dragon Plushie: +25% StaminaRegen, +5% BlockPoison, and Tannenbaum Plushie: -5% Bite Cooldown, +5% BlockFrostbite.
item.cardSummary: Ability that overwrites the effects of offensive ailment plushies with new ones, those being: Cat Plushie: +10% HealthRegen, +5% BlockBleed, Pig-Lantern Plushie: +5% Damage, +5%...

item.name: Volcanic
item.effect: Volcanic is a passive ability that grants users the ability to walk in lava without getting hurt or suffering status debuffs. During Famine and Drought, it additionally grants a 50% health regeneration boost and 25% thirst and hunger rate reduction. Volcanic does not protect a creature from Shadow Isle's corrupted lava.
item.cardSummary: Ability that grants users the ability to walk in lava without getting hurt or suffering status debuffs.

item.name: Will To Live
item.effect: Will To Live is a passive ability that allows the user to sprint without spending stamina. However, if stamina is depleted and the creature attempts to sprint, it will deal 3% of health every 3 seconds.
item.cardSummary: Ability that allows the user to sprint without spending stamina.
